measurements.unit: neurons/mm2 (neuronal density, not an absolute count)
measurements.method: histology, postmortem digital pathology (H&E, neuromelanin-guided manual annotation of LC boundary)
measurements.sample: human postmortem controls, n=73 (compared with n=768 Alzheimer's disease cases); rostral level defined by presence of superior cerebellar peduncle and cerebral aqueduct
measurements.quote: In the rostral LC, the median neuronal density was 34 neurons/mm 2 (interquartile range 22,44) in AD cases versus 60 neurons/mm 2 (50,89) in controls ( p < 0.001)
measurements.locationInPaper: Results, section on LC neuronal density by rostrocaudal level; also Table 1 'LC neuronal density differs among neuropathologically defined AD subtypes', row 'Rostral'

measurements.method: histology, postmortem digital pathology
measurements.sample: human postmortem controls, n=73; middle level defined by presence of superior medullary velum and fourth ventricle floor landmarks
measurements.quote: Similarly, in the middle LC, neuronal density was 38 neurons/mm 2 (27,57) in AD versus 79 neurons/mm 2 (46,104) in controls ( p < 0.001)
measurements.locationInPaper: Results, LC neuronal density section; also Table 1, row 'Middle'

measurements.method: histology, postmortem digital pathology

notFound: Oculomotor nuclear complex (nIII) - overall nucleus length/volume/neuron count (found only qualitative subnuclear serial-section descriptions in Horn/Büttner-Ennever-style histology, PMC3921678, with no single reported length/volume value that could be quoted as a discrete measurement)
Abducens nucleus - volume/length/neuron count (only indirect landmark: facial colliculus-to-obex distance, included above, not the nucleus itself)
Vestibular nuclei (medial, lateral, superior, inferior) - volumes or dimensions
Nucleus of the solitary tract - volume/neuron count/rostrocaudal extent
Dorsal motor nucleus of the vagus - volume/neuron count (only indirect surface landmark: vagal trigone dimensions, included above, not the nucleus itself)
Hypoglossal nucleus - volume/neuron count (only indirect surface landmark: hypoglossal trigone dimensions, included above, not the nucleus itself)

Inferior olivary complex - volume/dimensions of the nucleus itself (only found surgical-exposure-area geometry to the 'olivary safe entry zone', which describes operative access, not nucleus size, so it was excluded)
Pretectal olivary nucleus - any quantitative data
Interstitial nucleus of Cajal / riMLF - volume/dimensions/coordinates
Paramedian pontine reticular formation (PPRF) region - volume/dimensions/coordinates
